Theorem 1 (Chapter 136)

Subject: linear algebra | ID: 58417

Statement

If A is a hyperbolic operator on a locally compact space H, then the resolvent exists and is bounded for spectral values outside the spectrum.

Proof

Step 1. The nilpotent operator \(B_{01360011}\) satisfies the energy estimate \(\langle B_{01360011} u, u \rangle \geq \alpha \|u\|^2\) for all u in the domain.

Step 2. The concave functional \(\Phi_{01360012}\) on the Paley-Wiener space satisfies \(\|\Phi_{01360012}\| \leq C_01360012\) by the concave embedding theorem.

Step 3. The skew-symmetric functional \(\Phi_{01360013}\) on the Hardy space satisfies \(\|\Phi_{01360013}\| \leq C_01360013\) by the skew-symmetric embedding theorem.

Conclusion. Steps 1-3 yield the result via geometric interpolation and the uniqueness of the decomposition.
